description: Full-stack environment map — Docker containers, REST services, cron jobs, DB health, and live logs for both nidp-stack-vm and nivesh-app-vm (prod).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT container_name) FROM monitoring.container_health WHERE collected_at = (SELECT MAX(collected_at) FROM monitoring.container_health) AND environment IN ('prod','infra')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM monitoring.container_health WHERE collected_at = (SELECT MAX(collected_at) FROM monitoring.container_health) AND environment IN ('prod','infra') AND status = 'running'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM monitoring.container_health WHERE collected_at = (SELECT MAX(collected_at) FROM monitoring.container_health) AND environment IN ('prod','infra') AND (status != 'running' OR health = 'unhealthy')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM monitoring.v_latest_services WHERE is_up = true
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM monitoring.v_latest_services WHERE is_up = false OR is_up IS NULL
SELECT ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('OK','GREEN')))::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) * 100, 1) AS pct FROM nidp.job_log WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT name AS "Service", status AS "Status", cpu_pct AS "CPU%", mem_mb AS "Mem MB",
  uptime_h AS "Uptime h", resp_ms AS "ms", url AS "URL", _sort
FROM (
  SELECT container_name AS name,
    CASE WHEN status='running' THEN 'UP' ELSE 'DOWN' END AS status,
    COALESCE(ROUND(cpu_percent::numeric,1),0) AS cpu_pct,
    COALESCE(ROUND(mem_usage_mb::numeric,0),0) AS mem_mb,
    COALESCE(ROUND(uptime_seconds/3600.0,1),0) AS uptime_h,
    0 AS resp_ms, COALESCE(http_url,'') AS url,
    CASE WHEN status='running' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS _sort
  FROM monitoring.v_latest_containers
  WHERE environment='prod' AND container_name NOT LIKE 'c96cc%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT service_name,
    CASE WHEN is_up THEN 'UP' ELSE 'DOWN' END,
    0,0,0,COALESCE(response_ms,0),COALESCE(url,''),
    CASE WHEN is_up THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  FROM monitoring.v_latest_services
  WHERE environment='prod'
    AND service_name NOT IN ('nginx','grafana','minio','prometheus','timescaledb-prod')
) t ORDER BY _sort DESC, name

SELECT name AS "Service", status AS "Status", cpu_pct AS "CPU%", mem_mb AS "Mem MB",
  uptime_h AS "Uptime h", resp_ms AS "ms", url AS "URL", _sort
FROM (
  SELECT container_name AS name,
    CASE WHEN status='running' THEN 'UP' ELSE 'DOWN' END AS status,
    COALESCE(ROUND(cpu_percent::numeric,1),0) AS cpu_pct,
    COALESCE(ROUND(mem_usage_mb::numeric,0),0) AS mem_mb,
    COALESCE(ROUND(uptime_seconds/3600.0,1),0) AS uptime_h,
    0 AS resp_ms, COALESCE(http_url,'') AS url,
    CASE WHEN status='running' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS _sort
  FROM monitoring.v_latest_containers
  WHERE environment='staging'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT service_name,
    CASE WHEN is_up THEN 'UP' ELSE 'DOWN' END,
    0,0,0,COALESCE(response_ms,0),COALESCE(url,''),
    CASE WHEN is_up THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  FROM monitoring.v_latest_services
  WHERE environment='staging'
    AND service_name NOT IN ('timescaledb-stg')
) t ORDER BY _sort DESC, name

SELECT name AS "Service", status AS "Status", cpu_pct AS "CPU%", mem_mb AS "Mem MB",
  uptime_h AS "Uptime h", resp_ms AS "ms", url AS "URL", _sort
FROM (
  SELECT container_name AS name,
    CASE WHEN health='healthy' THEN 'HEALTHY'
         WHEN status='running' THEN 'RUNNING' ELSE 'DOWN' END AS status,
    COALESCE(ROUND(cpu_percent::numeric,1),0) AS cpu_pct,
    COALESCE(ROUND(mem_usage_mb::numeric,0),0) AS mem_mb,
    COALESCE(ROUND(uptime_seconds/3600.0,1),0) AS uptime_h,
    0 AS resp_ms, COALESCE(http_url,'') AS url,
    CASE WHEN status='running' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS _sort
  FROM monitoring.v_latest_containers
  WHERE environment='infra'
    AND container_name NOT IN ('nidp-loki','nidp-promtail','nidp-schema-registry')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT service_name,
    CASE WHEN is_up THEN 'UP' ELSE 'DOWN' END,
    0,0,0,COALESCE(response_ms,0),COALESCE(url,''),
    CASE WHEN is_up THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  FROM monitoring.v_latest_services
  WHERE environment='prod'
    AND service_name IN ('nginx','grafana','minio','prometheus')
) t ORDER BY _sort DESC, name

SELECT collected_at AS time, container_name AS metric, ROUND(cpu_percent::numeric,2) AS value FROM monitoring.container_health WHERE collected_at >= now() AND environment IN ('prod','infra')-interval'1 hour' AND cpu_percent IS NOT NULL AND cpu_percent > 0 AND container_name IN (SELECT container_name FROM monitoring.container_health WHERE collected_at >= now() AND environment IN ('prod','infra')-interval'1 hour' AND cpu_percent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY container_name ORDER BY AVG(cpu_percent) DESC LIMIT 10) ORDER BY collected_at

SELECT collected_at AS time, container_name AS metric, ROUND(mem_usage_mb::numeric,1) AS value FROM monitoring.container_health WHERE collected_at >= now() AND environment IN ('prod','infra')-interval'1 hour' AND mem_usage_mb IS NOT NULL AND mem_usage_mb > 0 AND container_name IN (SELECT container_name FROM monitoring.container_health WHERE collected_at >= now() AND environment IN ('prod','infra')-interval'1 hour' AND mem_usage_mb IS NOT NULL GROUP BY container_name ORDER BY AVG(mem_usage_mb) DESC LIMIT 10) ORDER BY collected_at

panels.title: REST Services — Latest Health Check
panels.description: Probed every minute from nidp-stack-vm. HTTPS probes cross-check Nivesh App VM externally.

targets.rawSql: SELECT vm, service_name, environment, url, is_up::text, http_status, COALESCE(response_ms,0) AS response_ms, COALESCE(error_msg,'') AS error, collected_at AS last_checked FROM monitoring.v_latest_services ORDER BY is_up ASC NULLS FIRST, vm, service_name

SELECT collected_at AS time, service_name AS metric, response_ms AS value FROM monitoring.service_health WHERE collected_at >= now()-interval'1 hour' AND is_up=true AND response_ms IS NOT NULL AND environment = 'prod'
ORDER BY collected_at

SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', collected_at) AS time, service_name AS metric, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN is_up THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END)::numeric,1) AS value FROM monitoring.service_health WHERE collected_at >= now()-interval'24 hours' GROUP BY time, service_name AND environment = 'prod'
ORDER BY time

panels.title: All Scheduled Jobs (both VMs)
panels.description: Static registry joined with nidp.source_registry for NIDP feeds. FAILED and overdue jobs sort to the top.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(sr.last_run_status,'NEVER')='FAILED' THEN 0
       WHEN sr.last_run_at IS NULL THEN 1
       WHEN COALESCE(sr.last_run_status,'NEVER')='PARTIAL' THEN 2
       ELSE 3 END AS sort_key,
  cr.vm, cr.job_name, cr.schedule_ist AS schedule,
  COALESCE(sr.last_run_status, 'NEVER') AS last_status,
  sr.last_run_at,
  ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - sr.last_run_at))/3600)::numeric,1) AS hours_since,
  sr.consecutive_failures AS cons_fail
FROM monitoring.cron_registry cr
LEFT JOIN nidp.source_registry sr ON sr.ingester = cr.job_name
WHERE cr.enabled = TRUE
  AND cr.job_name NOT IN ('container_health_collector','service_health_collector','gate4_replication_check')
ORDER BY sort_key, cr.vm, cr.job_name

panels.title: Infrastructure Services — Ports & URLs
panels.description: Static inventory of all infra tools running on both VMs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT v.vm, s.service_name AS tool, s.url AS health_url, s.is_up::text, s.response_ms AS resp_ms, s.http_status, s.collected_at AS last_checked FROM monitoring.v_latest_services s JOIN monitoring.vm_inventory v ON v.vm_name=s.vm WHERE s.service_name IN ('grafana','loki','promtail','prometheus','minio','timescaledb-prod','timescaledb-stg','daas-api','query-api','nginx') AND environment = 'prod'
ORDER BY v.vm, s.service_name
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database()
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND state='active' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat_activity%'
SELECT pg_database_size(current_database())
SELECT count(*) FROM timescaledb_information.hypertables
SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp()))::INT,0) AS lag_secs
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-xact_start)))::INT,0) AS oldest_txn_secs FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND xact_start IS NOT NULL AND state!='idle'

SELECT pid, usename AS user, state, ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-query_start))::numeric,1) AS duration_s, LEFT(query,120) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND state!='idle' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat_activity%' ORDER BY duration_s DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Grafana Alert Events (Last 24h)
panels.description: Alerts fired by Grafana alerting rules and stored via the webhook receiver.

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at, alert_name, state, severity, COALESCE(environment,'—') AS environment, labels::text AS labels FROM monitoring.alert_events WHERE received_at >= now()-interval'24 hours' ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 50
